config.name: Packets dropped by NICs
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toUInt64(greatest(0, sum(d))) AS "Packets dropped"
FROM (
  SELECT concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'], ' ', Attributes['device'], ' ', Attributes['direction']) AS series, max(Value) - min(Value) AS d
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'system.network.dropped' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY series
)

config.name: Dropped packets/s, by interface
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  series AS "Interface",
  rate AS "Dropped/s"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    series,
    sum(d) / $__interval_s AS rate,
    sum(sum(d)) OVER (PARTITION BY series) AS total
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ts,
      series,
      key,
      v - lagInFrame(v) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY ts) AS d,
      row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY ts) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
        concat(Attributes['device'], ' ', Attributes['direction']) AS series,
        concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'], '|', concat(Attributes['device'], ' ', Attributes['direction'])) AS key,
        argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
      FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName = 'system.network.dropped' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
      GROUP BY ts, series, key
    )
  )
  WHERE rn > 1 AND d >= 0
  GROUP BY ts, series
)
-- series that never moved would otherwise fill the legend with flat zeroes
WHERE total > 0
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Pod network errors
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  namespace AS "Namespace",
  pod AS "Pod",
  direction AS "Direction",
  toUInt64(greatest(0, max(Value) - min(Value))) AS "Errors"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] AS namespace,
    ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod,
    Attributes['direction'] AS direction,
    Attributes['interface'] AS interface,
    Value,
    TimeUnix
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.pod.network.errors' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
)
GROUP BY "Namespace", "Pod", "Direction", interface
HAVING "Errors" > 0
ORDER BY "Errors" DESC
LIMIT 30

config.name: Drops and errors by interface
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  node AS "Node",
  device AS "Interface",
  direction AS "Direction",
  toUInt64(greatest(0, maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.network.dropped')
                     - minIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.network.dropped'))) AS "Dropped",
  toUInt64(greatest(0, maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.network.errors')
                     - minIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.network.errors'))) AS "Errors"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS node,
    Attributes['device'] AS device,
    Attributes['direction'] AS direction,
    MetricName,
    Value
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName IN ('system.network.dropped', 'system.network.errors')
    AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
)
GROUP BY "Node", "Interface", "Direction"
HAVING "Dropped" > 0 OR "Errors" > 0
ORDER BY "Dropped" DESC, "Errors" DESC
LIMIT 30

config.name: Hubble · dropped flows/s, by peer
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ts,
  series AS "Source -> destination",
  rate AS "Drops/s"
FROM (
  SELECT
    ts,
    series,
    sum(d) / $__interval_s AS rate,
    sum(sum(d)) OVER (PARTITION BY series) AS total
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ts,
      series,
      key,
      v - lagInFrame(v) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY ts) AS d,
      row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY ts) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts,
        concat(if(Attributes['source'] = '', '?', Attributes['source']), ' -> ', if(Attributes['destination'] = '', '?', Attributes['destination'])) AS series,
        concat(ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'], '|', concat(if(Attributes['source'] = '', '?', Attributes['source']), ' -> ', if(Attributes['destination'] = '', '?', Attributes['destination']))) AS key,
        argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
      FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName = 'hubble_drop_total' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
      GROUP BY ts, series, key
    )
  )
  WHERE rn > 1 AND d >= 0
  GROUP BY ts, series
)
-- series that never moved would otherwise fill the legend with flat zeroes
WHERE total > 0
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Hubble · policy denials
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  direction AS "Direction",
  source AS "Source",
  destination AS "Destination",
  match AS "Match",
  toUInt64(greatest(0, sum(d))) AS "Denied"
FROM (
  SELECT
    Attributes['direction'] AS direction,
    if(Attributes['source'] = '', '?', Attributes['source']) AS source,
    if(Attributes['destination'] = '', '?', Attributes['destination']) AS destination,
    Attributes['match'] AS match,
    ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS node,
    max(Value) - min(Value) AS d
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'hubble_policy_verdicts_total'
    AND Attributes['action'] = 'dropped'
    AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY direction, source, destination, match, node
)
GROUP BY "Direction", "Source", "Destination", "Match"
HAVING "Denied" > 0
ORDER BY "Denied" DESC
LIMIT 30

config.name: Hubble · failed DNS answers
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  rcode AS "Response code",
  query AS "Query",
  source AS "Asked by",
  toUInt64(greatest(0, sum(d))) AS "Answers"
FROM (
  SELECT
    Attributes['rcode'] AS rcode,
    if(Attributes['query'] = '', '(query label not enabled)', Attributes['query']) AS query,
    if(Attributes['source'] = '', '?', Attributes['source']) AS source,
    ResourceAttributes['k8s.node.name'] AS node,
    max(Value) - min(Value) AS d
  FROM default.otel_metrics_sum
  WHERE MetricName = 'hubble_dns_responses_total'
    AND Attributes['rcode'] NOT IN ('', 'No Error')
    AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY rcode, query, source, node
)
GROUP BY "Response code", "Query", "Asked by"
HAVING "Answers" > 0
ORDER BY "Answers" DESC
LIMIT 30
